subject: Sprint: Renewal qualification — next steps & timeline
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Emily Tan <emily@codihealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Aug 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Sprint: Renewal qualification — next steps & timeline

Hi Emily — thanks again for carving out time today. Quick recap from our call and suggested next steps so we have the same priorities captured. Please confirm anything I missed.

Key pain points you called out
- End-of-day latency spikes on your conversational assistant (user timeouts at ~14:00–17:00 PT)
- Rising inference spend as you scale nightly batch summarization jobs
- Audit/compliance requirement: API traffic must be isolated to a VPC when we move to production

Current state / goals
- Current monthly usage: ~210M tokens (mix of chat+batch summarization). Peak QPS observed during business hours: ~60 rps.
- Primary goal for the next quarter: eliminate latency spikes, reduce per-token spend ~20%, prove Dedicated pool for batch throughput, and satisfy VPC/keys for audit.

New workloads discussed
- Nightly summarization: bulk jobs that would benefit from reserved throughput and batching
- Real-time triage assistant: low-latency conversational traffic that needs stable tail latency

Proposed pilot/upsell path (high level)
1) 6-week Dedicated pilot (reserved GPU pool sized for nightly summarization + small headroom for realtime)
2) Performance evaluation: latency and cost comparison vs hosted baseline (we'll provide token-level cost breakdown)
3) If results meet SLA targets, transition to 12mo reserved capacity with predictable pricing and an option for VPC/private deployment

Immediate next steps / asks (please respond with answers where you can)
- Confirm pilot scope: do you want us to prioritize nightly summarization throughput first, or split 60/40 with realtime assistant?
- Pilot start window: are you available to kick off the pilot week of Sept 14?
- Procurement/legal contact for SOW and standard terms (name + email)

Attachments: usage_report_aug.pdf (summary of last 3 months usage)
I will follow up with a draft SOW and an estimated cost model from Monica. Monica and Markus are copied if you want to loop them into any internal scheduling.

Thanks — Neha
Neha Kapoor
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0128

From: Emily Tan <emily@codihealth.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Rajiv Patel <rajiv@codihealth.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Aug 2026 16:09:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Sprint: Renewal qualification — next steps & timeline

Thanks Neha — this aligns with what we discussed. A couple clarifications:

- Priority: nightly summarization is the priority for Q4. Realtime assistant is important but can be part of phase 2 — we need the cost and latency wins on the batch jobs first.
- Pilot timing: week of Sept 14 works for us. Prefer to start on Tuesday (Sept 15) so our SREs can do preflight on Mon.
- Procurement: Rajiv Patel (rajiv@codihealth.com) will manage contracting and SOW sign-off. He is cc'd.

We also want to keep the pilot footprint minimal to start — targeting enough reserved capacity to cover our expected nightly peak (estimate ~1.4M tokens/hour during the 2-hour window). If you and Monica can propose a minimal Dedicated pool config, that would help speed approval.

Appreciate you sending the SOW and cost model.

—Emily
Emily Tan
Head of Product | CodiHealth
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Aug 2026 18:22:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: SOW draft + cost estimate (internal)

Neha / Markus — I put together a first-pass SOW and a conservative cost estimate based on their reported peaks. Highlights:
- Proposed pilot: 2x medium GPU instances (reserved for 6 weeks) with autoscale headroom for short bursts
- Expected cost delta vs hosted baseline: ~18–22% lower per-token after batching + KV cache for summarization flows
- Deliverables: pilot runbook, performance dashboard access, token-level cost report, and a short exec summary at week 4

Attachments: SOW_CodiHealth_draft.docx, internal_cost_estimate.xlsx (internal)

Recommendation: propose start 2026-09-15, Monica to lead pilot onboarding and join first two SRE syncs. I can share a pared-down config if we need to shrink the footprint further.

-Monica
Monica Patel
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.com

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Emily Tan <emily@codihealth.com>
Cc: Rajiv Patel <rajiv@codihealth.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 31 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Sprint: Renewal qualification — next steps & timeline

Emily — great, thanks for confirming priorities and Rajiv for looping in procurement.

I attached the SOW draft and the usage report (same files referenced earlier). Monica's internal cost estimate is internal-only; I'll provide a customer-facing cost summary in the SOW cover memo.

Proposed next actions:
- We lock pilot start: Sept 15 (Tue). Monica will begin onboarding call on Sept 15 at 10:00 AM PT. Please confirm Rajiv or your procurement lead can sign the SOW by Sept 10 to meet the timeline.
- Neha to schedule the kickoff invite (I'll send a calendar with the runbook and preflight checklist).
- Monica to publish the minimal Dedicated configuration by EOD tomorrow so you can confirm capacity.

If that all looks good I'll send the DocuSign link for the SOW once you confirm the procurement contact and the green light to proceed.

DocuSign preview: https://www.docusign.net/send/abcd-efgh-2026
SOW attachment: SOW_CodiHealth_draft.docx
Usage report: usage_report_aug.pdf

Thanks — looking forward to getting this rolling.
